leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define plugin lifecycle events
Implement a typed hook that exposes plugin lifecycle methods
Configure a plugin manager to register and manage typed hooks
Apply type constraints to ensure hook methods receive correct parameters
Integrate lifecycle events with a plugin execution pipeline
Manipulate plugin state through typed hook callbacks
Initialize a plugin system with proper TypeScript type safety
lessonTitle: Build typed plugin hooks with lifecycle events
